pillar_reactions.evidence: Confirmed alignment ('Yeah, absolutely') and had already tied mobility to his own humiliation with Trevor's free routine: 'I go into my bridge and I just started cramping. I was like, oh man, I'm so out of it... I can't even do Trevor's morning routine right now. That's a bummer, but new goal is humbling.' The travel-proof framing landed too: 'we'll make a lot of body weight routine for when you're traveling' / 'That makes sense.'

Took the sustainability framing without questions or pushback — the rep assessed him as 'already 80% of the way there. It's just optimizing and structuring it' and he agreed. He had already described a protein-first diet built around his fiancée's cooking and volunteered his own weak point, which is eating alone while travelling.

The strongest single reaction in the batch, and it was to the education-and-exit model rather than to accountability itself: 'that is a unique, the not coaching forever part... that whole philosophy and then, you know, and you even mentioned a comment of like, and helping those around you. Oh, that is not something that I've ever heard another coaching program ever mentioned at all... Interesting approach.'

anchors.raw: It's not a money issue for me. I guess I'm not worried about that part, but the philosophy
anchors.note: Proposed label: explicit_price_indifference. Volunteered before the price was named, in the middle of the pitch. He is the only prospect in the batch to disqualify money as a factor in advance, and he is the only one who bought — at full price, with no discount, plan or alternative tier offered or requested.

anchors.raw: I'm about to get married in August... we've got 68 days
anchors.note: Proposed label: hard_external_deadline. A fixed, emotionally loaded date nine weeks out, immediately followed by a honeymoon on a beach. It supplied all the urgency the call needed, which is why the absence of a consequence frame cost nothing here.

unmet_demand.want: Assurance he will hit a wedding-day aesthetic — roughly 13% body fat, ideally 10-11%, from 18% in under ten weeks
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The guarantee he was sold is denominated in kettlebell weight over six months ('a 20 pound heavier kettlebell in all the movements'), which says nothing about the 68-day body composition outcome that is the actual reason he bought. Nobody connected the two or set an expectation about what is achievable in nine weeks.

unmet_demand.want: Enough variety and novelty that he does not lose interest at month three, which he attributes to ADHD
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He raised it explicitly — 'being able to change while still being consistent with is also something that I need to take into account' — and it was never answered. The weekly plan adaptation plausibly covers it, but it was pitched as progression rather than as variety, so the concern was left open.
